method: Temporary external Rust test harness includes the existing runner source and a public-API copy of its canonical-case reconstruction helper. It links the existing raw-main/current libraries, without Cargo builds or changing any classification.

before.interpretation: Raw main reports no accepted pair, so the geometric guard passes.

current_unclassified.interpretation: The newly accepted nonstationary pair is not yet listed as known failing; the guard rejects it.

limits: The parent will run authoritative compiled crate tests after parallel edits settle and tracking/classification is resolved. The final source omits the tentative stale-known assertion: first-order stationarity alone cannot prove that a candidate is a minimum.

current_after_known_failure_classificati.interpretation: The mathematical counterexample is now explicitly classified as known failing, with no golden line; the guard passes without blessing the wrong result.
